:::{#cor-self-outer-product-trace}
#### The trace of a self outer product is a squared norm

For a vector $\vx$,
the [trace](#def-trace) of the [self outer product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-self-outer-product) $\soprod{\vx}$
and the square of the [Euclidean norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-euclidean-norm) $\norm{\vx}$
are the same number:

$$
\trf{\soprod{\vx}} = \norm{\vx}^2
$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\trf{\soprod{\vx}}
&= \trf{\oprod{\vx}{\vx}}
&& \text{(definition of the self outer product)}
\\
&= \tprod{\vx}{\vx}
&& \text{(the trace of an outer product is a dot product)}
\\
&= \norm{\vx}^2
&& \text{(the Euclidean norm from the dot product, squared)}
\ea
$$

The second step is @thm-outer-product-trace,
with $\vx$ in place of both $\vecf{u}$ and $\vecf{v}$.
The third step squares both sides of
[the formula for the Euclidean norm from the dot product](linear-algebra.qmd#thm-norm-dot-product).

:::
